requirements.resolution: A distinct route must complete source, product, protocol, result, independent-reconstruction and forward-paper gates without changing its frozen rule. C34 remains a failed limited proxy candidate; C37 is a public-primary historical-data no-go; C38/C40-C42 are non-admitted research dossiers; C39 is preregistered but unmeasured; C46/C47 is closed without a result; C48 has no formal historical route in the current environment; C49 finds only conditional future authorized-data categories, not a current accepted delivery; C50 is a distinct general-repo screen but has no stable five-percent yield floor or formal execution test; C51 is a distinct ETF-collar scope screen with no selected contract, positive five-percent floor, historical chain or execution evidence; C52 confirms that retained public SSE pages do not close C51's historical replay contract; R22 accepts C52's source control only while retaining VETO and four limitations; and R23 closes only R22-M-004's governance-registration follow-up while retaining the three substantive limitations. R21 closed R20's formula/source-control findings only for a fixed snapshot and does not resolve C51's substantive requirements. None resolves this blocker.
Satisfy every C18 acceptance test in missing_data_request_pack.json before freezing a test protocol.
Obtain and independently validate a lawful point-in-time universe, total-return treatment, costs, execution and eligibility evidence before defining a route protocol.

Retain a rights-cleared point-in-time total-return, distribution and fund-event ledger plus date-aligned current product terms, quote/depth, IOPV where applicable, fees, taxes, settlement and no-fill records. This does not override C34's strict limited proxy failure.
Complete six months of unchanged C34 forward paper observations with all required fields and independent review; this does not override the historical proxy failure or missing total-return evidence.

Complete C23-GATE-1: obtain written rights, a point-in-time sample including inactive funds, share-class total-return/event and historic fee/status fields, then independently reconcile to primary disclosures before a frozen rule design.

Obtain rights-cleared point-in-time market, event, availability and cost data for every declared board; if the scope includes BSE, obtain BSE historical coverage; then complete G0-G9 institutional equity-research diligence and independent review for every future included stock before a frozen rule design. C40-C42 are partial non-admitted dossiers, not a completion.

Obtain a written-rights, field-complete and versioned historical delivery that passes all C37 hard gates for point-in-time universe, return basis, events/terms, costs/settlement, executable market path, availability/revisions, auditability and pre-specification before freezing any new ETF hypothesis.

Obtain and independently accept the locked C39 universe, filing/event, corporate-action, decision-time execution and provenance package; then run frozen P1-P4 and the two-cycle F1 forward record without substitution, retuning or a portfolio-action inference.

Do not change the data profile or procure anything autonomously. If the user authorizes a licensed route, independently accept a written-rights delivery that closes point-in-time universe, total-return/event, availability/revision and decision-time execution gates before freezing a new formal protocol.

Do not select a repo code, term, broker, schedule or threshold. A separate C50 hypothesis would require a pre-frozen rule, rights-cleared point-in-time fixing/quote/order/settlement history, broker costs and permissions, independent annual/rolling reconstruction and forward paper observation. The dated official 1.391 percent one-day fixing provides no stable five-percent floor.

Do not select an ETF, option series, strike, expiry, size, broker, calendar or short-option structure. R21 closed R20 A/B only for the fixed repair snapshot; R22 accepts C52 only as a source-control and bounded-query audit, with actionability VETO; R23 closes only the R22-M-004 governance-registration follow-up. C52 confirms that retained public SSE pages do not supply the required replay contract. Before any separate collar protocol, independently accept a written-rights point-in-time option master, bid/ask/depth/trade and official-settlement records, underlying ETF total-return/event/adjustment ledger, dated cost/account evidence, and pre-frozen selection, roll and no-fill rules; then independently reconstruct annual and rolling outcomes and complete forward paper observation.
Remain not_publish_bound until at least one route becomes paper-operable, its strict evidence gaps are closed, and all release evidence is complete.

boundary: Open requirements are research controls, not investment instructions or proof that any future result will satisfy the long-run objective.
